spoiler-free.title: Tier Four
text: Six years after a thirteen-year-old walked into Callisto with a borrowed face, Jack Abbott holds a rank that doesn’t officially exist. The next contract on the board is already waiting for him.

This is where the spoiler-free career ends. What the tier 4 assignment is, what it costs, and what Jack and Aggie do about it, is the story of Coming of Age. Turn the Spoilers switch on after you’ve read it, and the game will follow the book to its ending.
Below is your debrief: everything Aggie tried to tell you on the way up, and what you made of it.

reader.title: Home is the people
text: The official record says that Aletheion courier Jack Abbott completed his tier 4 assignment on schedule, and that Nexus-77 was lost to a catastrophic systems failure, attributed to an act of terrorism by the Jackrabbit.

The unofficial record is a colony ship full of people who are alive, a corporate vessel with a quiet mind still working inside the machine, and an old courier ship with its old voice back, finally saying everything it had been holding for six years.
Below is your debrief: everything Aggie tried to tell you on the way up, and what you made of it.
